title: 第8章 裴家暗手第7章 夜闯矿栈
lines: 沈照夜回到西偏院时，天还没亮。
屋里只点着一盏小油灯，灯火被窗缝里的风压得很低。她坐在床边，手里握着那半只旧荷包。
看见沈照夜推门，她先松了一口气。
下一刻，她看见他背后的血。
沈霜立刻压住声音，眼睛却红了。
沈照夜走到床边，掀开床下那块松动地砖。
旧布条安安静静缠着，没有发热，也没有剑鸣。
他把半页账册取出来，用油纸包了三层，压进断剑旁边的缝里。
可沈霜这次没有给他说话机会。
衣服被污水和血黏在背上，沈霜用温水一点点揭开。揭到最后一道伤口时，她的手抖了一下。
裴七那一剑从后背斜划过去，口子不深，却长。
再偏半寸，就会伤到脊骨。
屋外忽然传来急促脚步声。
周野的声音隔着门压进来。
周野站在门外，脸上还沾着矿灰。
content_en:
When Shen Zhaoye returned to the West Branch, it was still dark.
Shen Shuang didn't sleep.
There was only a small oil lamp burning in the room, and the light was dimmed by the wind blowing through the cracks in the window. She sat on the edge of the bed, holding half of the old purse in her hand.
Seeing Shen Zhaoye push the door open, she breathed a sigh of relief.
The next moment, she saw the blood on his back.
"Brother."
Shen Zhaoye closed the door with his backhand.
"Quiet."
Shen Shuang immediately suppressed her voice, but her eyes turned red.
Shen Zhaoye walked to the bed and lifted up the loose floor tile under the bed.
Zhao Ye's broken sword is still there.
The old cloth strips were wrapped around quietly, without any heat or sword sound.
He took out half a page of the account book, wrapped it three times in oil paper, and pressed it into the slit next to the broken sword.
Shen Shuang watched his movements.
"What's that?"
"Account book."
"Is it related to dad?"
"Yeah."
Shen Shuang didn't ask again.
She just picked up the styptic powder.
"Sit down."
Shen Zhaoye wanted to say it was okay.
But Shen Shuang didn't give him a chance to speak this time.
"Sit down."
Her voice was soft but hard.
Shen Zhaoye sat down.
The clothes were stuck to his back with sewage and blood. Shen Shuang used warm water to peel them off bit by bit. When she reached the last wound, her hand shook.
Pei Qi's sword slashed diagonally across his back. The cut was not deep, but long.
If it's even half an inch off, it could hurt your spine.
Shen Shuang applied the hemostatic powder.
Shen Zhaoye's shoulders tensed up.
Suddenly there were rapid footsteps outside the house.
Zhou Ye's voice pressed in through the door.
"Shen Zhaoye, don't sleep."
Shen Zhaoye stood up and opened the door.
Zhou Ye stood outside the door, his face still stained with mineral ash.
"Registration for the first trial of Wenjian will be sealed in advance."
Shen Zhaoye's eyes darkened.
"When?"
"An hour later."
Zhou Ye glanced outside the hospital.
